title: Zinda rahey hussain
body:
Zinda rahey hussain
zinda rahe hussain tera gham manaayenge
ay fatema ke laal ye waada nibhaayenge
ghar me hamaare aayengi majlis me fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe aza ke saath ye dil bhi bichaayenge
jhule amaariyan ye shabihein ye taaziye
tehzeebe gham se dard ke manzar sajaayenge
ye unka hai julus jo pyaase huwe shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
ham iske raaste me sabilein lagaayenge
kehte hain chote chote se bachhe ye baap se
ek roz baba jaan ye alam ham uthaayenge
kuch der zuljanah mere ghar pe rok do
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaase ki is sawaari ko paani pilaayenge
bachpan se hai dua ke banaayenge ghar jahaan
ashur khaana ghar me wahaan ham sajaayenge
ghar me agar ho nazre sakina to hai yaqeen
<<DIVIDER>>
us nazr me sakina ke ammu bhi aaayenge
kis shaan ke mile hain namaazi hussain ko
teeron ke saamne ye musalle bichaayenge
bachhon ko apne sajda e shabbir ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
maatam ke saath saath namazein sikhaayenge
raahe hussainiyat ke shaheedon salaam lo
inko na apne dil se kabhi ham bhulaayenge
baade zahoor hoga moharram ka ye hasham
<<DIVIDER>>
ham karbala imam ke hamraah jaayenge
nauha bhi hai safeer e aza sarwar o hilal
jis des me bhi jaayenge nauha sunaayenge
